messages.subject: RStan Vignette?
parts:
I (and I'm guessing many others) could really do
with an RStan vignette that shows more about how
to get samples out of Stan and do something with them.

I'm not very good at R myself, but I assume that's
typical of our users.

I'd write such a thing myself, but it would almost
certainly fall short on both the R and Bayesian stats
side.

- Bob
